claims.statement: Equates specified GNN classes with constant-round anonymous distributed models under bounded degree and finite node features.
CPNGNN concatenates ordered consistent-port neighbor information; most-powerful claim is restricted to VVC and finite features.
Completeness encodes bounded local views and approximates a finite-label function; this is representability, not training convergence.

claims.statement: Degree-only tight MDS/MVC ratios are Delta+1 and2; weak coloring improves MDS and enables matching; proper coloring restricts to bipartite matching.

claims.statement: Only a four-node single-leaf toy experiment is reported, same graph for training/testing, ten seeds and10000 iterations; CPNGNN succeeds.
